column1: # ZAP baseline rules (zap.yml): rule id, action, name. Tab separated; lines
# starting with # are ignored. Raise a rule to FAIL one at a time, with a reason.
# vite preview cannot send the production headers. Both the user app and the
# console get theirs from Cloudflare _headers (ADR-0025), checked in the build
# Forms never submit to a server (form-action 'none'); requests carry a bearer
# token in a header, not a cookie, so there is nothing for CSRF to ride on.
# Decided 2026-10-22 (design §10): warnings with nothing to fix, kept quiet so a
# Cache policy is set in production, not by vite preview: the console sends
# no-store through _headers, the app caches through its service worker.
# The missing directive is frame-ancestors, which a meta CSP cannot carry. The
# console sends it in _headers (C1 checks); GitHub Pages cannot (accepted, ADR-0022).
